summary: PowerCompute, Inc. disclosed a secured borrowing facility via a non-recourse, collared 30-day Bitcoin loan from ChainFi (Arch Lending). The company's subsidiary borrowed $21.9 million against 307 Bitcoin, using proceeds to refinance a prior Arch loan and fund collar features. This is a routine financing agreement, not a special-situation event like an acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign. There is no strategic review, tender offer, or capital return. The filing is a standard 8-K disclosing a material credit facility obligation under Items 1.01 and 2.03, with no shareholder meeting or board action of special-situations nature.
